title: How the weather model is built and judged
desc: Numerical weather prediction models and AI weather models feed a blend trained on CRPS, which gives a probability for each daily-high temperature bracket. When the day settles, the outcome scores the forecasts for calibration and CRPS. A model change goes live only after pre-registered, leakage-safe walk-forward backtests and a statistical gate on a shadow model.
